summary: Completed testing of Flipwill/Arcanum tarot app focusing on daily card per-user functionality, improved text spacing, and removal of reflection sections. Core daily card requirements are working perfectly, but LLM integration is blocked by missing API key.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 error - LLM API key not configured
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks full card reading interpretation flow, prevents navigation to results page

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete full reading flow due to interpretation API failure

passed_tests: Daily card API returns different cards for different user_ids (user1: c04, user2: s06)
Same user_id returns consistent daily card on same day (both calls returned p03)
Home page loads correctly with daily card display
Card drawing API returns 3-card spread successfully
Frontend UI styling and layout appear correct
Daily card interpretation shows fallback text when LLM fails
action_item_for_main_agent: Configure EMERGENT_LLM_KEY environment variable in backend/.env to enable LLM interpretation functionality. The key should be set to enable the emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat API calls for card interpretations.
success_percentage: Backend: 83% (5/6 tests passed), Frontend: 90% (core functionality works but interpretation blocked)
